Follow #file:.github/copilot-instructions.md and #file:docs/01-product-spec.md.

STEP 1: PRODUCT PLAN. Create `docs/plan.md` containing:
1. Three user personas (new rider, weekend enthusiast, daily commuter) with goals and pain points.
2. User flows (as Mermaid diagrams) for: exploring a part, adding a bike, completing a care task, scanning a service bill, logging fuel.
3. Full screen inventory table: screen name, tab, purpose, key components, data needed.
4. Navigation map (tabs, stacks, modals, bottom sheets).
5. Risks and assumptions (especially around the Explorer gestures, SVG performance and notifications).
Do not write app code yet. When done, suggest running /step2-design-system.
